name: Viant

about:
Viant is a medical device contract manufacturer headquartered in Laconia, New Hampshire. The company traces its roots to 1968 when it entered the medical device market with precision metal tubing. Over five decades, it has expanded through acquisitions and organic growth to become a vertically integrated, single-source partner for OEMs and MedTech startups.

Viant provides end-to-end contract manufacturing from design and development through precision manufacturing, sterile and non-sterile device assembly. Its capabilities span precision metal tubing (including nitinol), extrusion, medical-grade plastics and silicone molding, micro-molding, machining, forming, welding, finishing, automated assembly, tooling, and coating. The company operates a global network of facilities with nearly 7,000 employees, offering cleanroom space and factory capacity across multiple continents.

Viant serves OEMs and startups across clinical markets including orthopedics (UHMWPE implants), surgical technology (minimally invasive, robotics, endoscopy), cardiac and interventional (hypotube components, overmolding), drug delivery (auto-injectors, IV sets, respiratory devices), bioprocessing (containment, filtration), bioelectronics (pain management, wearables), diagnostics (chromatography tubing), and respiratory care (masks, tracheal tubes).

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated model, ViaLaunch™ program management, and 1:1 engineering connections as differentiators. Leadership notes that frustration with existing contract manufacturers drove the creation of Viant to provide stronger risk mitigation, process validation, and scalable production volume.
